item.title: 'Yellowjackets' Season 4 Review: A Chaotic Finale That Goes Out on Its Own Terms
item.description: Endings are hard. As a viewer, watching the final season of a show you love adds an extra weight to every beat. Is this moment a callback to a previous season? What will be the overall arc of a character I've been invested in for years?

item.title: Epic Games Store Officially Makes Highly Rated Soulslike Free for a Limited Time
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 is finally out today around the globe. Unfortunately, it's only available on console at the moment, meaning plenty of gamers will have to wait until it arrives on PC . If you only have a PC and you're looking for something new to play, head over to the Epic Games Store. For a limited time, you can grab a great action-adventure game at no charge.

item.title: GTA 6 Brings Back a Legendary Rockstar Easter Egg
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 has only been out for hours, but players have already started discovering plenty of hidden details, including strange side quests and callbacks to previous games. A lucky few are reporting sightings of a creature that needs to be seen to be believed: Bigfoot.

item.title: Is Charlie Vickers finally playing the real Sauron?
item.description: Vickers said the mask is off, but is this Sauron more real than any of the others?

item.title: Avengers: Doomsday Teaser Officially Leans Into Marvel’s Messiest Relationship
item.description: Marvel's upcoming blockbuster Avengers: Doomsday is set to be a decades-spanning team-up for heroes across the MCU and beyond. In a series of new character posters , Marvel revealed that heroes won't be sticking to established teams like the X-Men, Thunderbolts, and Avengers, with Cyclops backing up Captain America while Bucky Barnes works with Shang-Chi. One pairing in particular has gotten fans talking, as it teases an incredibly messy love triangle from Marvel comics.

item.title: Winter Tokyo City region treasure hunt location in Forza Horizon 6
item.description: The winter Tokyo City region treasure hunt is one of the weekly activities in Forza Horizon 6 Series 7, "City Life." Whenever a new hunt begins, a box appears somewhere on the map and, to locate it, the only hints you have are the region's name and a picture. Completing this challenge helps you get closer to claiming the weekly and the Series cars.

item.title: GTA 6 Just Brought Back the Best E3 Meme of All Time
item.description: After years of waiting, Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 is finally here, and it's already astonishing players with its immaculately detailed environments, unexpected celebrity cameos, and absurdly interactive NPCs. Much like Leonida's various radio stations play all-time bangers and deep cuts, GTA 6 is also packed with references to memorable memes and pop-culture moments, and many of them are easy to miss. For instance, the game contains an homage to a hilarious viral moment from E3 2006, and it's not even a full-on side quest but a random discovery you'll stumble upon as you explore GTA 6 's intricate open world.

item.title: Should you defuse or provoke Mandy in GTA 6?
item.description: When you meet Mandy in Grand Theft Auto 6 for the first time, you can pick between the "defuse" and "provoke" dialogue options to determine how Jason is going to approach her during the conversation. This encounter takes place during the "Pipework" quest in Chapter 1. Jason is doing some jobs for Brian, who asked him to collect the rent from a couple of tenants. Mandy is one of them, but her condition for paying the rent is that her sink be fixed, and she specifically asked for Jason to come and help her.

item.title: Where to find strip clubs in GTA 6
item.description: There are several strip clubs in Grand Theft Auto 6 , but they're hard to find, especially if you're spending most of your time in Key Lento. Have no fear; if you can't wait to watch scantily clad women move to music in GTA 6 , there's an early-game strip club that offers private dances.

item.title: Fortnite Adds New Way to Get the Pirate Shop Token
item.description: The Pirate Shop Access token is the most sought-after item in Fortnite history, guaranteeing a total of four weeks of free Item Shop goodies. Nearly every player has been actively searching for it, opening as many chests as they can per match, even if it costs them their in-game lives.
